title: Fireproof Lizard Roundup
wikitext:
{{Infobox Quest |image= File:BotW Fireproof Lizard Roundup.png |caption= |type= Side |game= BotW |giver= [[Kima]] |location= Southern Mine |prereq= |reward= {{Icon List|BotW| * Flamebreaker Armor }} |previous= |next= }} "{{Term/Store|Fireproof Lizard Roundup||Series, BotW}}" is a [[Side Quest]] in {{BotW}}.{{Cite|{{Big|Fireproof Lizard Roundup}}
{{Color BotW|Side Quest|Southern Mine}}|Adventure Log|BotW}} ==Overview== At the [[Southern Mine]], Link can encounter [[Kima]], who remarks that he showed up at the right time.{{Cite|Oh, hey! Perfect!
You showed up at just the right time.|Kima|BotW}} Kima goes on to explain that he just returned from [[Goron City]], but he forgot to pick up souvenirs.{{Cite|I'm on my way back from {{Color BotW|Blue|Goron City}} but forgot to buy souvenirs.|Kima|BotW}} Now, he is scouring the Southern Mine for [[Fireproof Lizard]]s, though he is having difficulty catching them due to fast they are.{{Cite|I wanted to capture some of those {{Color BotW|Blue|fireproof lizards}} that live here on Death Mountain, but those suckers are quick.|Kima|BotW}} If Link can catch him 10 Fireproof Lizards, Kima promises to give him some [[Fireproof Armor]].{{Cite|Say, you look pretty speedy. I bet you could catch a ton! If you bring me {{Color BotW|Red|10}}, I'll even give you some heat-resistant armor. So what do you say, buddy? Help a pal out of a jam by capturing me some {{Color BotW|Blue|fireproof lizards}}?|Kima|BotW}} When Link accepts, Kima thanks him and suggests searching the area around them.{{Cite|[Leave it to me!] Great! Thanks, buddy! Just {{Color BotW|Red|10}} {{Color BotW|Blue|fireproof lizards}} should be enough. You can probably find some right around here!|Kima|BotW}} This begins the [[Side Quest]]. Fireproof Lizards are plentiful in the Southern Mine. They can be found basking on their own or by lifting up rocks. The [[Sheikah Sensor]] can also help Link locate nearby Fireproof Lizards. After gathering all 10 Fireproof Lizards, Link can return to Kima.{{Cite|Wow, look at all them {{Color BotW|Blue|fireproof lizards}}! You actually managed to chase down {{Color BotW|Red|10}} of those suckers?!|Kima|BotW}} Honoring his deal, he gives Link [[Fireproof Armor]] in exchange for the Lizards.{{Cite|Well, a deal's a deal. Hand them over and I'll give you this heat-resistant armor.|Kima|BotW}}{{Cite|Thanks, buddy! Here, take this.|Kima|BotW}} Kima notices that Link seems disappointed.{{Cite|...Hmm? Something the matter, buddy?|Kima|BotW}} When he realizes that Link wanted his [[Flamebreaker Helm]], he says it is too expensive to lend out and he should buy his own in Goron City.{{Cite|My helmet? Sorry, it ain't for lending! It's too expensive for that. You can buy your own in {{Color BotW|Blue|Goron City}}.|Kima|BotW}} He gives Link directions, guiding him north on the trail.{{Cite|To get to {{Color BotW|Blue|Goron City}}, head north from here. It's the fifth stop up the trail.|Kima|BotW}} Kima then states it is always handy to have spare souvenirs.{{Cite|I'm sure you'd agree, buddy, that it's always handy to have some spare souvenirs on hand.|Kima|BotW}} From there on, Kima will offer to pay 20 [[Rupee]]s every time Link brings him three Fireproof Lizards.{{Cite|So if you come across any more {{Color BotW|Blue|fireproof lizards}}, I'll buy them off you at {{Color BotW|Red|20 rupees}} for {{Color BotW|Red|three}}.|Kima|BotW}} He expresses a desire to use them to make [[Fireproof Elixir]]s.{{Cite|And if I get my hands on some {{Color BotW|Blue|fireproof lizards}} and some {{Color BotW|Blue|monster parts}}... I can make some {{Color BotW|Blue|fireproof elixirs}} to boot!|Kima|BotW}} Once he is done talking, the Side Quest will be completed. ===Objectives=== {{Quest Objectives |- | 1 | Kima at the Southern Mine has asked you to catch ten of the {{Color BotW|Red|fireproof lizards }}found on Death Mountain near the Southern Mine.

Go get {{Color BotW|Red|10 fireproof lizards}}, and take them to Kima. |- | Complete | As thanks for the {{Color BotW|Red|10 fireproof lizards}}, Kima gave you his flamebreaker armor!

Not only that, but Kima will pay you {{Color BotW|Red|20 rupees}} for every {{Color BotW|Red|three}} {{Color BotW|Red|fireproof lizards}} you bring him. }} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Fireproof Lizard * Kima * Southern Mine }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |side-quests= BotW }}
